attempts.text: {"claims":[{"claim_text":"Support for the right of the United States citizens of Puerto Rico to be admitted to the Union as a fully sovereign state after they freely so determine.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Recognition that Congress has the final authority to define the constitutionally valid options for Puerto Rico to achieve a permanent non-territorial status with government by consent and full enfranchisement.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"As long as Puerto Rico is not a state, the will of its people regarding their political status should be ascertained by means of a general right of referendum or specific referenda sponsored by the U.S. government.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
